data.body: Measurement correction from the parent RCA: 51,853,550 bytes is the objectsize:disk sum for ALL .bridge_state blobs added since rewrite baseline 1300f383, not for peer_confirmations.json alone. Path-specific measurement from the frozen fresh clone is 417 unique peer-confirmation blobs, 320,864,708 raw bytes, and 6,077,416 objectsize:disk bytes after Git delta compression. The current file remains 1,400,452 bytes and the no-op rewrite mechanism remains confirmed, so this is still legitimate churn to fix; its packed-size magnitude and its non-causal relationship to the greater-than-1-GiB checkout are corrected here. Reproduction: git rev-list --objects tickets -- .bridge_state/peer_confirmations.json, feed object ids to git cat-file --batch-check with objectsize and objectsize:disk, then sum blob rows.
